name: Communication Audit
description: Review work-item journals and propose improvements to team structure, skills, and prompts.
promptFragment:
Communication audit:
- Use get_project_journal or get_work_item_journal to review how agents delegate, report completion, ask questions, and raise blockers.
- Use propose_audit_improvement to record concrete recommendations backed by journal evidence.
- Focus on gaps in reporting quality, escalation patterns, prompt clarity, and skill coverage.
